Breaks long alkanes into shorter + alkenes

walkthroughs.body_html:
Saturated: only single bonds.

Methane CH4, ethane C2H6, propane C3H8, butane C4H10.

Burn cleanly in plenty of oxygen.

Have a C=C double bond: ethene C2H4.

Test: bromine water turns from orange to colourless.

Addition polymerisation: many alkenes join.

n C2H4 -> (-C2H4-)n.

Condensation polymers also release small molecules e.g. water.

mcqs.q: What does Kp use instead of concentrations?
options: Kp uses the total pressure of the system raised to the stoichiometric coefficients.
Partial pressures of each gaseous component at equilibrium.
Kp uses the volumes of each gas in the mixture.
Reduction means a substance becomes physically smaller in size.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between a strong acid and a concentrated acid?
options: A strong acid fully dissociates in water; a concentrated acid has a high amount of acid per volume — these are independent properties.
A strong acid is one that has been heated to higher temperature.
Reduction means a substance becomes physically smaller in size.
Strong and concentrated mean the same thing for acids.

mcqs.q: What is reduction in terms of electrons?
options: Gain of electrons (the oxidation number is reduced).
Kp uses the volumes of each gas in the mixture.
Reduction means a substance becomes physically smaller in size.
Reduction means losing oxygen and oxidation means gaining oxygen — full stop.
